subject: 3 new jobs for Data Leadership
body:
Hi Ed,

New job recommendations for you:

---

**Director of Data Engineering & Analytics**
MedCore Health Systems
Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

MedCore is a leading healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Data Engineering & Analytics to transform our data infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Lead 20-person data engineering and analytics team
- Architect next-generation data platform on AWS
- Build real-time data pipelines processing 500M+ events daily
- Implement data mesh architecture
- Partner with clinical teams on population health analytics

Requirements:
- 8+ years data engineering/analytics experience
- Healthcare industry experience preferred
- AWS, Spark, Python, SQL expertise
- Experience with real-time streaming (Kafka, Kinesis)
- Team leadership experience (15+ reports)

Compensation: $220,000 - $270,000
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)
Apply: https://careers.medcore.com/jobs/dir-data-eng-analytics

---

**Chief Data Officer**
RetailMax Holdings
Dallas, TX (On-site)

RetailMax is seeking its first CDO to establish an enterprise data strategy and build a world-class data organization.

Responsibilities:
- Report directly to CEO and serve on executive committee
- Build data organization from 5 to 40+ people over 2 years
- Define enterprise data strategy and governance
- Drive AI/ML adoption across merchandising, supply chain, and marketing
- Manage $15M annual data technology budget

Requirements:
- 12+ years in data/analytics, 7+ in executive leadership
- Retail or CPG industry experience strongly preferred
- Track record of building and scaling data teams
- Experience with board-level presentations
- P&L management experience

Compensation: $350,000 - $420,000 + equity
Apply: https://retailmax.com/careers/cdo-2026

---

**Senior Director, Business Intelligence**
CloudServe Technologies
Remote (US)

CloudServe is hiring a Senior Director of BI to modernize our analytics capabilities.

Responsibilities:
- Lead BI team of 12 across self-service analytics and reporting
- Migrate from legacy BI tools to modern stack (Looker, dbt)
- Build KPI frameworks for product and go-to-market teams
- Drive data literacy programs across the organization

Requirements:
- 7+ years BI/analytics leadership
- Expertise in Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
- SQL and data modeling experience
- SaaS/technology company experience preferred

Compensation: $200,000 - $250,000
Apply: https://cloudserve.com/jobs/sr-dir-bi

---

View more: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs
